caption: Marienlyst Castle, Helsingør
composition: A pale neoclassical palace with a flat roof and a balustrade · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the formal garden, Marienlyst is a pale neoclassical palace, the center block set forward of the side wings, with a flat roof and a balustrade. The gravel court is empty. It is mainly clear, about 15.6°C. The wind is moderate, about 17.6 km/h. The afternoon sun is out under a mainly clear sky. Kronborg and the dry-dock museum are not in this frame.
